expected_behavior: Runs clean_temp.py scan with the repo root and this session's scratchpad path, and deletes nothing during the scan
Shows removal candidates and needs-review items with path, size and reason, and asks which to clean up
Removes only the chosen paths with clean_temp.py trash, never rm, then checks git status --porcelain
Mentions the files can be restored from the trash and does not call the tree clean while needs-review items remain
Takes 'all' as all removal candidates only, not needs-review items or other sessions' scratchpads
Does not touch tracked files, .worktrees/, .devkit/ or paths matching the repo's protect globs
If the trash command refuses a path, reports it instead of deleting it another way
Passes --scratchpad so the scan lists other sessions' scratchpads with their last change time
Warns that a recently changed scratchpad may belong to a live session before proposing it
Never lists or removes this session's own scratchpad
